event_text: Starclan said that m_c would die from a great danger that would threaten the clan this moon, but {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} didn't know when yet. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} soon found out how soon when a pack of coyotes was chasing r_c through the territory and r_c, blinded by pure terror, didn't know that {PRONOUN/r_c/subject} {VERB/r_c/were/was} leading the coyotes toward the camp! Luckily, m_c was just nearby and noticed the coyotes chasing r_c. So m_c distracts the coyotes while r_c escapes and m_c loses a life or two as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} gets mauled by the coyotes, saving the cats of c_n from the danger foretold.

history.lead_death: were mauled by a pack of coyotes while saving r_c and whole the Clan
